run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a given bulk crystal index
build_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: build a function to enumerate symmetrically distinct slab surfaces from a bulk crystal structure
create_standardize_bulk: create a function that standardizes a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen structure is symmetric with respect to the z-direction
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen structure by flipping it upside down along the z-axis
